target.name: Epsilon Indi B
target.description: Closest binary brown dwarf pair (Eps Indi Ba/Bb), located ~6.7 arcmin from bright star Epsilon Indi A, moving at ~4.7 arcsec/yr.
target.scientific_notes: Targeted directly on the brown dwarf binary component Eps Indi Ba/Bb (~6.7' away from Eps Indi A) and propagated to the SPHEREx observation epoch.
